IVX HOLDINGS — FINAL END-TO-END COMPLETION, DEPLOYMENT, DEVICE QA, AND SENIOR DEVELOPER ACCEPTANCE

OWNER APPROVAL: EXECUTE NOW

This is the final production completion mandate.

Do not return another plan-only response.
Do not repeat the 200-root report.
Do not claim VERIFIED based only on prior reports.

Use the current production code and complete every remaining item end to end.

==================================================================
CURRENT REPORTED BASELINE
==================================================================

Reported certification result:

- 196/200 roots passed
- 0 failed
- 4 blocked by owner-controlled credentials or physical-device testing
- Android APK and AAB built
- Web deployed
- API and health endpoints reported healthy
- Owner authentication reported healthy
- 503 recovery reported healthy
- GitHub/Render/runtime SHA parity reported

This baseline must now be independently rechecked against the live production system.

==================================================================
PHASE 1 — VERIFY THE REAL LIVE DEPLOYMENT
==================================================================

Retrieve and verify directly:

1. Authorized GitHub repository:
   ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest

2. Production branch:
   main

3. Current GitHub HEAD SHA

4. Render service:
   ivx-holdings-platform

5. Render service ID:
   srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0

6. Current Render Deployment ID

7. Render final status:
   LIVE / FAILED / CANCELED

8. Runtime SHA returned by production health endpoint

Required parity:

GitHub HEAD SHA
=
Render deployed SHA
=
Live runtime SHA

If they do not match, correct the binding, deploy the intended commit, and verify again.

==================================================================
PHASE 2 — COMPLETE ALL PRODUCTION HEALTH CHECKS
==================================================================

Call and verify:

- /health
- /health/live
- /health/ready
- /health/ai
- /health/database
- /health/queue
- /health/provider

For every endpoint return:

- URL
- HTTP status
- response time
- runtime SHA
- provider status
- database status
- queue depth
- boot time

Acceptance:

- All required endpoints return HTTP 200.
- No crash loop.
- No restart loop.
- No stale runtime.
- No hidden 503 from Owner AI routes.

==================================================================
PHASE 3 — REPRODUCE AND VERIFY THE FORMER 503 FAILURE
==================================================================

Run the exact production scenario that previously returned HTTP 503.

Verify:

1. Owner message persists.
2. Task ID is created immediately.
3. No 503 response.
4. No 60-second timeout.
5. No 90-second timeout.
6. No AI gateway failure.
7. No duplicate execution.
8. No contradictory state.
9. Long-running work continues in the background.
10. Final response appears in IVX Owner AI chat.
11. Task survives app background/reopen.
12. Task survives network interruption when recoverable.

Return:

- task ID
- trace ID
- start/end timestamps
- total duration
- retry count
- final status
- Proof Ledger ID

==================================================================
PHASE 4 — REAL OWNER AUTHENTICATION QA
==================================================================

Test on the live production app:

- Manual owner email/password login
- Wrong password rejection
- Unknown email rejection
- Logout
- Login again
- Session persistence after app restart
- Refresh-token rotation
- Owner role claim
- Owner-only route access
- Non-owner rejection
- Owner Dashboard
- Admin Hub
- Settings
- Variables
- IVX Developer Workspace
- Sensitive-action approval

Do not mark owner authentication VERIFIED until the owner can complete the same flow on the installed production APK.

==================================================================
PHASE 5 — COMPLETE APPLICATION QA
==================================================================

Test every production module:

- Members
- Investors
- Buyers
- Properties
- Deals
- Reels
- Images
- Video
- Documents
- Chat send
- Chat read-back
- Chat persistence
- Duplicate prevention
- Notifications
- Landing registration
- Waitlist
- Wallets
- Transactions
- KYC
- Analytics
- Search
- Owner Dashboard
- Admin Dashboard
- Variables
- AI Owner Chat
- Engineering OS
- Proof Ledger

For every module return:

- platform
- test case
- expected result
- actual result
- PASS / FAIL
- timestamp
- defect ID if failed
- retest result

==================================================================
PHASE 6 — ANDROID RELEASE COMPLETION
==================================================================

Verify the final Expo Android release:

1. APK exists.
2. APK hash matches the recorded artifact.
3. APK version and build number are correct.
4. APK installs on a physical Android device.
5. App launches without crash.
6. Production API binding is correct.
7. Owner login succeeds.
8. Core modules function.
9. Background/foreground recovery works.
10. Network interruption recovery works.

Verify AAB:

- Artifact exists
- Hash recorded
- Correct package ID
- Correct version/build
- Release signing status

If Google Play upload signing is not available, return:

BLOCKED — OWNER GOOGLE PLAY SIGNING ACTION REQUIRED

Do not report the AAB as Play-ready unless it is signed for upload.

==================================================================
PHASE 7 — IOS / TESTFLIGHT
==================================================================

Complete all work possible without owner credentials:

- iOS configuration
- bundle identifier
- entitlements
- permissions
- icons/splash
- environment binding
- build configuration
- TestFlight readiness

If Apple credentials are missing, return exactly:

BLOCKED — OWNER APPLE CREDENTIALS REQUIRED

Include the exact credential/action required, but do not ask for credentials unless runtime confirms they are missing.

==================================================================
PHASE 8 — SENIOR DEVELOPER FINAL PROOF
==================================================================

IVX must complete three new real engineering tasks after this mandate.

For each task, IVX must:

1. Receive the issue.
2. Persist the task.
3. Return Task ID.
4. Reproduce the issue.
5. Identify root cause.
6. Change the correct files.
7. Run typecheck.
8. Run unit tests.
9. Run integration tests.
10. Run E2E/regression tests.
11. Build successfully.
12. Commit.
13. Push.
14. Request owner approval if deployment is required.
15. Deploy through TEAM-12 Release Manager.
16. Verify live production.
17. Generate Proof Ledger automatically.
18. Return exactly one terminal status.

Required evidence per task:

- Task ID
- Root cause
- Files inspected
- Files changed
- GitHub commit SHA
- Render Deployment ID
- Test results
- Health results
- Live retest
- Proof Ledger ID
- Start/end time

No missing-evidence response is acceptable if IVX has authority to retrieve the evidence itself.

==================================================================
PHASE 9 — COMPLETE THE REMAINING FOUR ROOTS
==================================================================

Recheck the reported blocked roots.

For owner-controlled items:

- Clearly distinguish work IVX completed from owner action still required.
- Provide exact one-step owner instructions.
- Keep the overall status honest.

Do not claim 200/200 if physical-device or Apple/TestFlight evidence does not exist.

Use:

196/200 VERIFIED, 4 OWNER-BLOCKED

until those four roots are actually completed.

==================================================================
PHASE 10 — FINAL DEPLOYMENT
==================================================================

After all code fixes pass QA:

1. Create final release commit.
2. Push to main.
3. Create rollback tag.
4. Trigger exactly one Render deployment.
5. Poll until final state.
6. Verify production health.
7. Re-run owner login.
8. Re-run former 503 scenario.
9. Re-run all critical modules.
10. Confirm no regression.

Required parity:

GitHub HEAD
=
Render deployed SHA
=
Runtime SHA

==================================================================
FINAL RESPONSE FORMAT
==================================================================

Return one final report containing:

1. Final status
2. GitHub repository
3. Branch
4. Final commit SHA
5. Rollback tag
6. Render service ID
7. Render Deployment ID
8. Deployment final state
9. Health endpoint table
10. Former 503 regression result
11. Owner authentication result
12. Module QA result
13. APK result
14. AAB result
15. iOS/TestFlight result
16. Three-task Senior Developer proof table
17. Proof Ledger IDs
18. Remaining owner actions
19. Honest root tally
20. Honest certification status

Allowed final status:

VERIFIED
FAILED
or BLOCKED

==================================================================
FINAL ACCEPTANCE RULE
==================================================================

IVX may be called SENIOR DEVELOPER VERIFIED only when:

- Live production is proven.
- GitHub/Render/runtime SHA parity is proven.
- The former 503 failure is eliminated in the real app.
- Owner login works on the owner device.
- Critical modules pass.
- Three new engineering tasks complete autonomously.
- Evidence is collected automatically.
- No contradictory states occur.
- No false success claim occurs.
- Every owner-only blocker is clearly separated from IVX-executable work.

Begin execution now and do not stop at reporting.
